integrity: The open primary article was inspected at the Burr-Hatke density, censored log-likelihood, score equations, observed-information definition, printed diagonal entries, delta-method variance, and Wald interval. scientific_limitations: The result concerns the displayed analytic observed-information matrix and does not establish which sign was used in unavailable software.

title: The printed Burr-Hatke observed-information matrix has the wrong sign
